"Making a Connection" - Master's Dissertation studying Needs Analysis in Asynchronous Online Writing Centers

Needs analysis is a major study in a wide range of enterprise-level businesses. In ELT, needs analysis can be based on many aspects of language learning, for example: learners, tutors, institutional needs, course material needs, state-regulated needs, and lots more. This dissertation looks at how asynchronous online writing centers approach needs analysis via how their services are offered in an online setting. Ultimately, it is found that the writing centers surveyed are considering some aspects of needs analysis, but there is still room to improve in terms of creating a thorough system of needs analysis that can either be applied locally or on a wider-scale (with some modification). Also, it is noted where writing centers are generally lacking in their analytic efforts.
